description: Corrected GTEx comparison using the true canonical ITIH5 transcript ENST00000397146
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Accept":"application/json"}
rows=[];page=0
while True:
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianTranscriptExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000123243.14","datasetId":"gtex_v8","page":page,"itemsPerPage":2000},
        headers=H,timeout=120)
    j=r.json(); rows+=j.get("data",[])
    pg=j.get("paging_info",{})
    if page>=pg.get("numberOfPages",1)-1: break
    page+=1
piv=pd.DataFrame(rows).pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="transcriptId",values="median")

CANON="ENST00000397146.6"   # Ensembl canonical, 942 aa, CCDS31139.2, NM_030569.7 = Q86UX2-1
ISO2 ="ENST00000397145.6"   # 702 aa, NM_001001851.3 = Q86UX2-2
ISO3 ="ENST00000613909.4"   # 728 aa, CCDS31140.2, NM_032817.6 = Q86UX2-3, internal TSS
piv["total"]=piv.sum(axis=1)

print("CORRECTION to the previous block: the Ensembl canonical transcript is ENST00000397146")
print("(942 aa, CCDS31139.2, NM_030569.7), not ENST00000397145 (702 aa = isoform 2).\n")
for name,t in [("canonical Q86UX2-1",CANON),("isoform 2 Q86UX2-2",ISO2),("isoform 3 Q86UX2-3",ISO3)]:
    print(f"{name:20s} {t}: median {piv[t].median():7.2f} TPM, max {piv[t].max():7.2f} ({piv[t].idxmax()}), "
          f">1 TPM in {(piv[t]>1).sum():2d}/54 tissues")
ratio=piv[ISO3]/piv[CANON].replace(0,np.nan)
share=piv[ISO3]/piv["total"].replace(0,np.nan)
print(f"\nisoform3 / canonical TPM ratio: median {ratio.median():.3f}, "
      f"IQR {ratio.quantile(.25):.3f}-{ratio.quantile(.75):.3f}, range {ratio.min():.3f}-{ratio.max():.3f}")
print(f"isoform3 share of all ITIH5 transcript signal: median {100*share.median():.1f}%")
print(f"tissues where isoform 3 exceeds canonical: {(piv[ISO3]>piv[CANON]).sum()}/54")
print("\ntop 10 tissues by total ITIH5:")
print(piv.sort_values("total",ascending=False)[[CANON,ISO2,ISO3,"total"]].head(10).round(2).to_string())
piv.round(4).to_csv("/agent/jobs/751146a9-dc23-49c8-ac3a-da13249e67c2/provenance/itih5_gtex_transcript_tpm.csv")

top=piv.sort_values("total",ascending=False).head(18)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,6.4),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.5,1]})
y=np.arange(len(top))
ax[0].barh(y-0.26,top[CANON],height=0.26,color="#2b6cb0",label="ENST00000397146, canonical Q86UX2-1 (signal peptide)")
ax[0].barh(y,      top[ISO2], height=0.26,color="#dd6b20",label="ENST00000397145, Q86UX2-2 (signal peptide)")
ax[0].barh(y+0.26, top[ISO3], height=0.26,color="#c53030",label="ENST00000613909, Q86UX2-3 (no signal peptide)")
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels([t.replace("_"," ") for t in top.index],fontsize=8)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xlabel("median TPM, GTEx v8")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False,loc="lower right")
ax[0].set_title("18 highest ITIH5-expressing GTEx tissues",fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(piv[CANON]+0.01,piv[ISO3]+0.01,s=36,color="#4a5568")
lim=[0.05,200]
ax[1].plot(lim,lim,"--",color="#a0aec0",lw=1,label="equal")
ax[1].set_xscale("log");ax[1].set_yscale("log");ax[1].set_xlim(*lim);ax[1].set_ylim(*lim)
ax[1].set_xlabel("canonical ENST00000397146, median TPM")
ax[1].set_ylabel("isoform-3 ENST00000613909, median TPM")
ax[1].set_title(f"Isoform-3 transcript exceeds canonical in\n{(piv[ISO3]>piv[CANON]).sum()} of 54 tissues (RSEM estimates)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
plt.suptitle("GTEx v8 transcript quantification places substantial ITIH5 signal on the signal-peptide-free isoform-3 transcript",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
